title: Zebronics Type C to HDMI Cable, 4K @ 60Hz | 1080p @ 240Hz, 18Gbps Data Transfer, Type-C 3.1 Gen 1, 3D Compatible, 3M (9.8ft) Braided Cable, For Laptop, Mobile, iPad Pro, MacBook, Chromebook (CHA20)
description: CABLE TYPE: The cable offers high-performance, high-bandwidth connectivity with Type-C to HDMI 2.0, while maintaining backward compatibility for effortless use with older devices. CONNECTIVITY: Featuring Type-C 3.1 Gen 1, this cable ensures smooth connectivity across compatible devices. DATA TRANSFER: With data transfer speeds up to 18 Gbps, this cable provides ultra-fast bandwidth for smooth visuals and advanced gaming performance. HIGH RESOLUTION: Provides sharp, clear visuals with 4K at 60Hz and 1080p at 240Hz support, ideal for gaming and video streaming. CABLE LENGTH: Built for effortless connectivity, this 3-meter braided cable delivers increased strength and durability for reliable, long-term use. 3D COMPATIBLE: Supports 3D video formats to provide an immersive viewing experience, enhancing visuals with vivid depth and realism. PLUG & PLAY: Enjoy effortless plug-and-play setup with gold-plated connectors that ensure reliable, stable, and high-quality signal transmission. Note: USB-C port must support "DisplayPort Alternate Mode". NOT support Portable Monitor. Not HDMI Female Port.
